headline: EPS more than doubles sequentially, edges up year-over-year
summary_short: NTT reported Q2 FY2026 basic EPS of ¥3.38, up 144.9% q/q and up 7.6% y/y.
summary_long: Basic EPS of ¥3.38 rose 144.9% sequentially from ¥1.38 and 7.6% year-over-year from ¥3.14. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data.
